gloss: to accomplish; to achieve; to carry out

definitions.gloss: to accomplish; to achieve; to carry out to completion
definitions.explanation: To see something through to the end, to bring an endeavor or process to completion. Often used for significant achievements or transformations.

examples.japanese: この{街|まち}は{大|おお}きな{発展|はってん}を{遂|と}げた。
{長年|ながねん}の{努力|どりょく}の{末|すえ}に、ついに{夢|ゆめ}を{遂|と}げることができた。
examples.english: After years of effort, I was finally able to fulfill my dream.

notes:
{遂|と}げる is a transitive ichidan verb with a literary, formal tone. It emphasizes completion and finality.

ASPECT (ている):
Rarely used in the ている form. The focus is on the completed result rather than an ongoing state.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- Aを{遂|と}げる (accomplish A)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {目的|もくてき}を{遂|と}げる (accomplish an objective)
- {成長|せいちょう}を{遂|と}げる (achieve growth)
- {発展|はってん}を{遂|と}げる (achieve development)
- {変貌|へんぼう}を{遂|と}げる (undergo a transformation)
- {進化|しんか}を{遂|と}げる (achieve an evolution)

Also appears in the compound verb {成|な}し{遂|と}げる (to accomplish, to achieve), which is even more emphatic. The expression {死|し}を{遂|と}げる means "to meet one's death" (literary).
